notes: allwatchnews.com is a Jekyll aggregator (no WordPress API/sitemap) linking to 15 external watch publications; it has no article pages of its own, so url is the original publication article URL and category is "Aggregator: <publication>". All 2026 items (6164 from 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-21) were pulled via its public More-Stories JSON endpoint until 2025-12-22. Release vs excluded was decided by title keyword heuristics only (inclusion: introducing/new/launches/unveils/debuts/edition/hands-on etc.; exclusion: review/podcast/best/guide/vs/why/how/interview/business/auction/etc., and "New releases from X, Y and more" roundups), so some false positives (e.g. hands-on of pre-2026 watches, news items) and false negatives (releases with neutral titles) remain. Brand/model left empty (no structured fields); refs not extracted because articles are external and releases exceed ~600.
